subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: The current bug is source-reproducible, but the submitted union_id direction depends on a disputed API field and changes message admission behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent identity contract.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Refresh this PR or replace it only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and updating all mention admission paths.

options.title: Document Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu exposes no reliable cross-app bot identity for bots, keep requireMention conservative and document the supported multi-bot workaround.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Multi-Bot Work
options.body: Use the canonical issue as context for a larger Feishu identity/session design if maintainers want one change to solve admission, bot visibility, and context scope together.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Refresh this PR or replace it only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and updating all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned/reviewed this PR and already identified the Feishu identity decision surface as non-mechanical.
